correctness.rationale: Conditionally uniform exchangeable surviving subsets give an exact two-parent transfer identity. A nested-set hypergeometric stochastic coupling and convex increments make each concentration transfer nonnegative. Every integer majorization has a chain of these transfers. Joint-retention moment expansion gives common mean a q1+b q2 and variance gap 2 Delta sum binom(m_i,2)(q3-q4). Strictness/equality follow for all admissible R, corroborated by exact independent enumeration and coefficient extraction over 1,244 cases.

value.rationale: Primary removal by a uniformly random fixed-size subset and bottom-up specialist coextinctions are ecologically motivated. Despite profile-independent mean survival, every convex survivor-count risk is ordered solely by the majorization of specialist allocation, with exact and sharp strictness stages under an arbitrary exchangeable initial-removal law. This is a complete structural dispersion characterization, not a parameter-tuned special case.
